# `schemaUnionOfLiterals`

Suggests combining multiple Schema.Literal calls in Schema.Union into a single Schema.Literal

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `off` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377038` |
| Language Service name | `schemaUnionOfLiterals` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/schema-union-of-literals` |

## Preview

```ts
import * as Schema from "effect/Schema"

export const preview = Schema.Union(Schema.Literal("a"), Schema.Literal("b"))
/**
                       ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(schema-union-of-literals): This `Schema.Union` contains multiple `Schema.Literal` members and can be simplified to a single `Schema.Literal` call.
*/
```
